attributes.name: Dagger of Doubling
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4+1; you may additionally discard this card to add another 1d4, then search your deck for a weapon that has the Knife trait and add it to your hand.

When playing another weapon, you may discard this card to add 2d4 to your combat check.
